highlights: Lead development of C++ and Python flight software that runs fiber-optic loopback bit error rate (BER) tests at 25.875 Gbps and sends telemetry to the ground.
Own the Yocto Project builds of the custom embedded Linux images that run on flight hardware.
Drive on-board model serving with Ray Serve, quantizing models and running multiple models concurrently on FPGA boards.
Architected an autonomous rover navigation stack in ROS2: 3D SLAM with LIO-SAM, a tuned Nav2 for motion control, and open-vocabulary object detection with text-based waypoints.
